claim: G-uilint: 패널 스타일: 반경 토큰(≤2px)·CEP 10(Chromium 74) 미지원 CSS 금지
G-vet: go vet (mac + windows 크로스 + tools)

ref.value: $ sh -c cd helper && go vet ./... && GOOS=windows go vet ./... && cd ../tools && go vet ./...

claim: G-jsx: ExtendScript 타입 검사(Premiere DOM 타입, noLib)
G-core: 패널 코어 테스트(프로토콜 계약 포함)
G-helper: Helper 전체 테스트 + 성능 기록(로컬 E2E 포함)
G-ui: 패널 UI 골든: DOM 구조(어디서나) + 픽셀(고정 환경에서만), 실제 Controller를 가짜 Helper로 구동
골든 README가 픽셀 골든 24개와 DOM 골든 22개를 빠짐없이 나열한다

ref.value: $ sh -c set -eu; test "$(find panel/cep/test/golden/chrome-154-darwin27-arm64 -type f -name "*.png" | wc -l | tr -d " ")" = 24; test "$(find panel/cep/test/golden/dom -type f -name "*.json" | wc -l | tr -d " ")" = 22; for f in panel/cep/test/golden/chrome-154-darwin27-arm64/*.png panel/cep/test/golden/dom/*.json; do rg -q "$(basename "$f")" panel/cep/test/golden/README.md; done

claim: 로컬 빌드·테스트·배포 산출물은 제외되고 소스·문서·골든은 제외되지 않는다

ref.value: $ sh -c set -eu; git check-ignore artifacts/macos/Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip >/dev/null; git check-ignore helper/.perf >/dev/null; git check-ignore panel/cep/dist >/dev/null; ! git check-ignore README.md >/dev/null 2>&1; ! git check-ignore docs/releases/0.2.0.md >/dev/null 2>&1; ! git check-ignore panel/cep/test/golden/README.md >/dev/null 2>&1; git diff --check

claim: GitHub Release v0.2.0이 공개 상태이며 Windows x64·macOS ZIP의 크기와 SHA-256이 검증된 로컬 산출물과 일치한다

ref.value: $ sh -c set -eu; repo=Jeon-HyeongJoon/birdcage; tag=v0.2.0; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)" = false; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json isPrerelease --jq .isPrerelease)" = false; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json assets --jq ".assets[] | select(.name == \"Birdcage-Windows-x64-0.2.0.zip\") | .size")" = 77977524; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json assets --jq ".assets[] | select(.name == \"Birdcage-Windows-x64-0.2.0.zip\") | .digest")" = sha256:0130893421e601839d264ba9a2ff85a19a0d1531938747f5ffcb1b34249c5e2f; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json assets --jq ".assets[] | select(.name == \"Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip\") | .size")" = 60893853; test "$(gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json assets --jq ".assets[] | select(.name == \"Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip\") | .digest")" = sha256:53113d936d238df68c20d99282ce575eebe6245e84ac1052614cc538dce1b41b; curl -fsSIL "https://github.com/$repo/releases/download/$tag/Birdcage-Windows-x64-0.2.0.zip" >/dev/null; curl -fsSIL "https://github.com/$repo/releases/download/$tag/Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip" >/dev/null; gh release view "$tag" -R "$repo" --json url,assets --jq "{url: .url, assets: [.assets[] | {name, size, digest, state, url}]}"

claim: 비공개 GitHub Release v0.2.0에서 인증 다운로드한 Windows x64·macOS ZIP의 SHA-256이 검증된 로컬 산출물과 일치한다

ref.value: $ sh -c set -eu; tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/birdcage-release.XXXXXX"); case "$tmp_dir" in */birdcage-release.*) ;; *) exit 2;; esac; trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir"' EXIT; gh release download v0.2.0 -R Jeon-HyeongJoon/birdcage --dir "$tmp_dir" --pattern "Birdcage-*.zip"; test "$(stat -f %z "$tmp_dir/Birdcage-Windows-x64-0.2.0.zip")" = 77977524; test "$(shasum -a 256 "$tmp_dir/Birdcage-Windows-x64-0.2.0.zip" | awk '{print $1}')" = 0130893421e601839d264ba9a2ff85a19a0d1531938747f5ffcb1b34249c5e2f; test "$(stat -f %z "$tmp_dir/Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip")" = 60893853; test "$(shasum -a 256 "$tmp_dir/Birdcage-macOS-0.2.0.zip" | awk '{print $1}')" = 53113d936d238df68c20d99282ce575eebe6245e84ac1052614cc538dce1b41b; gh release view v0.2.0 -R Jeon-HyeongJoon/birdcage --json url,assets --jq "{url: .url, assets: [.assets[] | {name, size, digest, state, url}]}"
